_help: days    : '3-6' range | '1,3,5' list | '2-8/2' every other | '4' one day
times   : M=Morning A=Afternoon E=Evening N=Night B=Bedtime. Combine: 'M,A' or 'M,A,E,N'. No times = M,A,E,N: Bedtime must be listed
move    : bare pattern name, or {pattern, speed, distance, axis, radius}
requires: 'beaten: NAME' | 'met: NAME' | 'flag: NAME', any prefixed with 'not '.
Compound gates use the longhand object form.
when    : optional rule list, evaluated TOP TO BOTTOM, FIRST MATCH WINS.
A rule states when the character is present plus ONLY what differs.
Anything a rule omits falls back to the character's own value above.
loop    : set false for story characters who must never repeat when the
calendar loops -- they are matched against the real day instead.
THE TCG CLUB. Reachable only once the Gym Challenge is complete AND the player has
bought club membership from the receptionist downstairs (flag town_hall_club_member).
CALENDAR: a 3-day rota looping days 8-10 for ever (day 11 = day 8, 12 = 9, ...).
The Gym Challenge cannot be finished before day 13, so the rota is always running
by the time anyone gets up here. Put rotating club opponents on '8', '9', '10'.
THE CARD ELDERS live here every day once gym_challenge_complete is set (they leave
the ground floor at the same moment). Same opponent names as downstairs, so they
already count as beaten: single matches now (match_format "" overrides the
constants' best_of_3) and no first-win x3 reward, since that is first-win only.
